requirements.project_name: PayGuard Autonomous Fraud Detection & Payment Gateway

functional_requirements.title: Real-Time Transaction Scoring
functional_requirements.description: The system shall evaluate payment transactions in real time using ML risk inference models and assign a dynamic fraud probability score.

functional_requirements.title: Adaptive Multi-Factor Challenge
functional_requirements.description: The system shall trigger biometric or SMS one-time password challenges for transactions evaluated above the baseline risk threshold.

functional_requirements.title: Merchant Dispute & Chargeback Workflow
functional_requirements.description: The system shall provide authorized merchants with a dispute resolution interface to submit supporting documentation and evidence for contested charges.

functional_requirements.title: Regulatory Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Reporting
functional_requirements.description: The system shall generate automated Suspicious Activity Reports (SAR) for cumulative cross-border wire transfers exceeding statutory thresholds.

non_functional_requirements.description: The scoring engine must deliver sub-second risk evaluations during high-volume merchant checkout peaks.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: 99th percentile transaction inference latency under 120ms at 5,000 requests per second

non_functional_requirements.description: All payment card numbers and transaction payloads must adhere strictly to PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Hardware Security Module (HSM) AES-GCM-256 tokenization with zero plaintext primary account number persistence

non_functional_requirements.description: The authorization core must maintain continuous operational uptime across multi-region clusters.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: 99.999% uptime availability with zero data loss (RPO = 0, RTO < 5 seconds)

non_functional_requirements.description: Fraud detection rules and ML models must be hot-reloadable without service restart.
non_functional_requirements.target_metric: Zero-downtime model swap completed within 10 seconds across active gateway nodes

design_constraints: Containerized microservices running on Python 3.11+ with gRPC and REST endpoints
Strict PCI-DSS v4.0 and GDPR Article 25 regulatory compliance
PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB extension for audit logs and ledger idempotency
external_interfaces: Visa Direct & Mastercard Send Processing Networks
AWS KMS / CloudHSM Cryptographic Key Management
assumptions_and_dependencies: Payment clearing networks respond to authorization calls within 2.5 seconds
Merchant integration uses TLS 1.3 mutual authentication (mTLS)

component_responsibility_matrix.responsibilities: TLS termination, mTLS validation, token rate limiting, and replay attack prevention
Feature extraction, ML model evaluation, risk scoring, and challenge decision matrix
Double-entry transaction ledgers, currency conversions, and network gateway dispatch
SAR report generation, regulatory audit trails, and immutable ledger archiving
